_comment: Kayo Specialization. Roll a 6 sided die, gain action points equal to half the number rolled (rounded down). The draw was gated on a DIE_ROLLED_SIX flag that nothing ever set -- roll() records no such flag -- so it could never fire. roll() now records the die faces as turn events, which is turn-scoped as the text requires: an earlier roll of a 6 this turn counts even though this card's own roll was not a 6.

on_success._comment: action points are an asset, not a combat keyword

effects._comment: resolves now, not at end of turn
